rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or just above it. Booleans take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option; _1/_2/_3 follow the printed option order). Item 14-21 amounts pair a peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right (money_joins). Schedule 1.A and 1.B rows 2-5 print no row number and take the column header above (row 1 is the header-adjacent row). The 2000OT layout has no writer keys for the Tax Agent block or the Part III payment rows, so those cells stay blank. Multi-comb MM/DD/YYYY dates and the single 14-slot page 1 and page 2 TIN combs stay blank.
